preconditions.description: The number of commands n must be between 1 and 500,000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= x <= 1023 for x in constants)
preconditions.description: Each constant x must be a non-negative integer between 0 and 1023.

preconditions.expression: all(op in {'&', '|', '^'} for op in operations)
preconditions.description: Each operation must be one of the bitwise operations: AND (&), OR (|), or XOR (^).

postconditions.description: The length of the output program k must be between 0 and 5.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= x <= 1023 for x in output_constants)
postconditions.description: Each constant in the output program must be a non-negative integer between 0 and 1023.

postconditions.expression: all(op in {'&', '|', '^'} for op in output_operations)
postconditions.description: Each operation in the output program must be one of the bitwise operations: AND (&), OR (|), or XOR (^).
